text: Work abstention on 03.08.2026 — All members to abstain from court duties in protest against police atrocities on advocate at Hindupur. The Governing Body appeals for full cooperation.
Group Insurance Scheme extended to all active members — Members requested to submit updated details at the Association office at the earliest.
New Digital Library Wing inaugurated at the Bar Association Hall — SCC Online, Manupatra and AIR terminals now available for members.
Free Legal Aid Camp held at Ibrahimpatnam in collaboration with DLSA — Over 300 villagers benefited on land rights, family disputes and pension matters.
Annual subscription fee due — All members are requested to pay before 30 September 2026 to avoid suspension of membership.
Moot Court Competition 2026 — Open to law students from recognised institutions in Andhra Pradesh. Registration closes 10 October 2026.
Constitution Day Seminar held successfully — Chief Guest: Hon'ble Sitting Judge, AP High Court. Over 400 advocates attended the programme at Bar Association Hall.
